landing.title: Where do your <u>168 hours</u> go?
landing.intro: Every week has exactly 168 hours, the same for everyone. Fill in a few simple sentences about sleep, work, food and the rest of your life, and see how much free time is really left.
landing.intro2: Then picture your ideal week and compare the two, to find the hours you'd like to win back.
landing.credit: Inspired by Laura Vanderkam's book 168 Hours and by Ali Abdaal, who both show that we have more time than we think.
landing.areasText: Every hour lands somewhere. Whatever is left over is your free time.

current.title: Your current week
current.text: Answer sentence-style questions about how you spend your time right now.

ideal.title: Your ideal week
ideal.text: Fill in the same questions for the week you'd love to have.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See which areas gain or lose time, area by area.

landing.privacy: 🔒 Private by design: no accounts, no tracking. Your answers are saved only in this browser.
